[[Drim Cindershot]] is a [[Charr]] boss that possesses armor-piercing skills like his [[Charr Stalker]] brethren; he also has the ability to self-heal and enhance his arrows even further through [[Favorable Winds]].

**{{NPC location|The Breach}}

*{{skill icon|Troll Unguent}}

*[[Charr Carving]]
